description: This file is a script written in JavaScript using Node.js modules. It collects, analyzes, and compares inventory data related to plugin extension import boundaries in a TypeScript codebase, including validation against baseline files.

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Compares two inventory entries for sorting purposes based on file, line, kind, specifier, and reason.

methods.name: classifyResolvedExtensionReason
methods.description: Classifies the reason for a resolved extension path, indicating whether it's an extension implementation, entry point, or owned file.

methods.name: pushEntry
methods.description: Appends an entry to the entries array.

methods.name: scanImportBoundaryViolations
methods.description: Scans a source file for import boundary violations related to plugin extensions and returns a list of entries.

methods.name: scanWebSearchRegistrySmells
methods.description: Detects certain patterns in 'src/plugins/web-search-providers.ts' that indicate registry smells or hardcoded plugin IDs/providers.

methods.name: shouldSkipFile
methods.description: Determines whether a file should be skipped based on its path pattern.

methods.name: collectPluginExtensionImportBoundaryInventory
methods.description: Aggregates inventory data for plugin extension import boundaries across the source roots, filtering out skipped files.

methods.name: readExpectedInventory
methods.description: Reads the baseline expected inventory from a JSON file.

methods.name: diffInventory
methods.description: Diffs the expected and actual inventory entries.

methods.name: formatInventoryHuman
methods.description: Formats the inventory into a human-readable string for reporting.

methods.name: formatEntry
methods.description: Formats a single inventory entry into a string.

methods.name: runPluginExtensionImportBoundaryCheck
methods.description: Runs the baseline inventory check for plugin extension import boundaries, handling I/O operations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point to execute the check script; exits with appropriate code.
